codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of configurable sim responses. Five new config structs (FaultLogConfig, FilterCyclesConfig, FilterCycleConfig, InformationConfig, SpaConfigConfig) with Default impls matching original hardcoded values. Four setter methods on SpaSim. All four generate methods updated to use configured data. Config response correctly adapts temperature scale bit from SpaState. 12 well-structured tests covering all assertions (VAL-MQTT-019 through VAL-MQTT-024) including configurability, default preservation, valid frame production, full round-trip through SpaSim→FrameDecoder→dispatch, and temperature scale adaptation. No bugs or missed edge cases found.

summary: PASS. The implementation fully covers all feature requirements: fault log, filter cycles, information, and config responses are configurable via typed config structs with setter methods on SpaSim. Default behavior is preserved via Default impls. Config response correctly adapts the temperature scale bit from SpaState. 12 new tests provide comprehensive coverage including round-trip verification through the full protocol pipeline (SpaSim→process_incoming_bytes→FrameDecoder→dispatch). All 485+ workspace tests pass. Protocol encoding is correct — the encoder produces the right sub-type bytes (0x28 for fault, 0x23 for filter, 0x24 for info, 0x2E for config) which the dispatcher correctly maps to typed IncomingMessage variants. The worker followed the rust-worker skill procedure without deviations.
